blocks.text: Waybar shows workspaces, application shortcuts and status modules. Module tooltips explain their purpose. The system settings button opens native GTK menus; Help is the entry immediately below Files. Quick controls can reveal on hover according to the installed theme.

The managed configuration is ~/.config/waybar/config with module fragments under modules/ and styles under style/. Native popup definitions are in gtk/. Use Desktop Appearance for supported presentation changes. Syntax errors in JSON or CSS can prevent a bar from starting.

If a menu opens but an action fails, record the specific action and check its owning unit/log. After saving work, use the existing Restart Waybar menu action when you intend to restart the bar. Do not repeatedly launch unmanaged copies.

The clock, audio, Bluetooth, notification, capture, power, Tomat and Wayscriber controls have menus with named actions. Help in a popup opens its related guide. The system settings popup places Help directly below Files; that Help item opens the desktop guide.

Bar status text can contain font glyphs, including Tomat phase and playback indicators. Popup rows use regular theme artwork. These have different configuration inputs: replacing a timer status character with an icon filename will print the name as text. Wayscriber tray artwork uses its colored style; neither choice changes the annotation tools.
